story.iWant: to execute user acceptance testing on Epic 2's MCP query tool
story.soThat: Epic 2 is officially validated complete before building Epic 3 on top of it

tasks.task: MCP Server Setup (10 minutes) Follow Story 3.0.3 setup guide - Edit ~/.claude/mcp.json, Add RAGLite configuration, Use absolute path Restart Claude Desktop - Quit completely, Reopen and wait Verify connection - Check Settings > MCP, Confirm "RAGLite" appears Troubleshoot if needed - Use troubleshooting section from Story 3.0.3, Fix any connection issues

Execute UAT Script (30-60 minutes) Open UAT script - File: docs/uat/epic-2-financial-queries-uat.md Verify prerequisites - Qdrant running, PostgreSQL running, MCP connected Execute Test 1 (Simple Metric Query) - Ask query in Claude Desktop, Record actual result, Mark pass/fail Execute Tests 2-10 - Repeat for each test scenario, Note usability issues Complete results summary - Count passes/fails, Calculate pass rate, Overall result

UAT Results Review (30 minutes) Present results to team - Share completed UAT script, Discuss findings Team decision - Evaluate pass rate, Decide: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL Update Epic 2 status - If PASS: Mark Epic 2 officially complete, If PARTIAL/FAIL: Create action items

acceptanceCriteria.criterion:
MCP Server Setup (10 minutes) Connect Claude Desktop to RAGLite MCP server
- Use Story 3.0.3's setup guide (docs/setup/mcp-configuration.md) - Add MCP configuration to ~/.claude/mcp.json - Use absolute path to RAGLite project - Restart Claude Desktop and verify connection
- MCP server configured (using Story 3.0.3 guide) - Claude Desktop shows "RAGLite" in connected servers - No connection errors in logs
Ricardo successfully connects (validates Story 3.0.3 guide clarity). If connection fails, Story 3.0.3 guide needs improvement.

Execute UAT Script (30-60 minutes) Test all 10 Epic 2 scenarios and record results
- Open UAT script: docs/uat/epic-2-financial-queries-uat.md - Verify prerequisites: Qdrant, PostgreSQL, MCP server connected - Execute 10 test scenarios (Simple Metric Query, Period Normalization, Multi-Entity Comparison, Fuzzy Entity Matching, Hybrid Search, Table-Aware Chunking, Currency Limitation Handling, Budget vs Actual Detection, Source Attribution Accuracy, Response Time) - Record actual result for each test, mark pass/fail, note usability issues - Complete results summary
- All 10 test scenarios executed - Actual results recorded for each test - Pass/fail marked for each test - Results summary completed - Usability feedback documented
docs/uat/epic-2-financial-queries-uat.md

UAT Results Review (30 minutes) Team reviews results and decides Epic 2 status
- ≥80% pass rate → PASS: Epic 2 officially complete, proceed to Epic 3 - 60-79% pass rate → PARTIAL: Create UX improvement stories, schedule follow-up UAT - <60% pass rate → FAIL: Epic 2 NOT complete, fix issues, re-run UAT
- Team reviews UAT results - Decision made: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL - Epic 2 status updated accordingly - Action items created (if needed)

constraints.constraint: This is a MANUAL UAT story executed by Ricardo (Project Lead), not a development story. No code changes required.
Story 3.0.3 (MCP Setup Guide) must be complete - Ricardo needs setup instructions to connect.
Story 3.0.4 (UAT Framework Templates) must be complete - UAT framework and templates required for execution.
Requires Qdrant and PostgreSQL running via docker-compose before UAT execution.
Epic 2 status depends on UAT pass rate: ≥80% = complete, 60-79% = needs improvement, <60% = not complete.
All UAT results must be documented in docs/uat/epic-2-financial-queries-uat.md with actual results, pass/fail marks, and usability feedback.
Team decision required after UAT execution - not a solo activity. Bob (SM), Murat (Test Architect), Winston (Architect) should participate.

tests.standards: This story uses MANUAL UAT (User Acceptance Testing) per testing-strategy.md for user-facing feature validation. No automated tests required. UAT framework defined in docs/process/uat-framework.md. Success measured by pass rate: ≥80% PASS (Epic 2 complete), 60-79% PARTIAL (needs improvement), <60% FAIL (not complete). Ricardo executes 10 test scenarios, records actual results, marks pass/fail, documents usability feedback.

ideas.idea: Test 1: MCP Connection Validation - Verify Claude Desktop shows "RAGLite" server after configuration. Test pass criteria: Server visible in Settings > MCP, no connection errors.
Test 2: Setup Guide Clarity - Ricardo follows Story 3.0.3 guide without assistance. Test pass criteria: Connection successful within 15 minutes, no confusion or unclear steps reported.

Test 3-12: 10 Epic 2 Test Scenarios - Execute all scenarios from UAT script (metrics, periods, entities, hybrid search, tables, attribution, response time). Test pass criteria: Each test marked pass/fail based on expected vs actual results.
Test 13: Usability Feedback Collection - Ricardo documents usability issues during testing. Test pass criteria: Feedback section completed with specific observations (not just "works fine").

Test 14: Team Review Process - Team reviews results and makes decision. Test pass criteria: Decision documented (PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL), sprint-status.yaml updated if PASS, action items created if PARTIAL/FAIL.
